text:
elaine (PM): dropping a compact patch for Alerting SLO UI. three asks: 1) make channel preview compact, 2) swap 'suppression' => 'Silences', 3) keyboard flow for +N expansion. figma: https://figma.redwood/alerts/compact-quick
omar (Design): sketching a two-chip inline preview + a +N chip. +N opens an overlay (absolute positioned) with per-channel actions (simulate/remove). overlay should not shift layout.
jess (Frontend): implement notes: render two avatars + a +N button. lazy-mount overlay on first open, debounce preview updates by 300ms. use initials svg fallback for avatars to avoid network blocking.
toni (A11y): accessibility checklist: +N must be a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. overlay should be role=menu with roving tabindex for arrow navigation. focus must return to +N on close and the simulate modal must be role=dialog with focus trap. chips need 4.5:1 contrast and visible focus ring.
omar (Design): copy tweak: label silence toggle "Silence notifications" and helper text "Silences pause outgoing alerts; incidents remain visible for audit." Also show a tiny "custom" badge if preset is overridden and an inline Undo link after editing.
jess (Frontend): backend contract: persist `preset_id` + `threshold_override` so we can show source. sample send shape: {"preset_id":"critical_v1","threshold_override":"p95>1.6s"}.
preview-bot: snapshot: https://images.redwood/preview/1792000001-01.png
elaine (PM): shipping checklist before review Friday:
- [ ] compact preview + +N overlay (omar + jess)
- [ ] simulate modal + sample payload (jess)
- [ ] "Silence" copy + helper (omar)
- [ ] preset/custom badge + undo (omar + jess)
- [ ] a11y focus/aria checks (toni)

omar (Design): will push updated figma and tag preview-bot. ping if any blockers.
